title: DJI Mini 4 Pro: The Ultimate Travel Drone
subtitle: Small enough to fly anywhere, powerful enough to capture everything
author: SkyHigh
content:
The sub-250g drone category has always been about compromise—until now. The DJI Mini 4 Pro destroys the notion that small drones can't be pro tools. With omnidirectional obstacle sensing and 4K/100fps slow motion, it's a beast in a tiny package.

Flight Performance

Despite its light weight, the Mini 4 Pro handles wind surprisingly well. I took it up in 30km/h gusts on the coast, and the footage remained rock steady thanks to DJI's legendary gimbal stabilization. The O4 transmission system provides a crystal-clear feed up to 20km away (though you should always fly within visual line of sight!).

The Mini 4 Pro stays stable even in challenging wind conditions.

Camera Quality

The 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensor captures stunning dynamic range. The new 'Night Mode' is a game-changer for twilight flights, reducing noise significantly. And yes, true vertical shooting returns, making this the perfect drone for TikTok and Instagram Reels content creators.

ActiveTrack 360°

The standout feature is ActiveTrack 360°. You can now trace a path on the controller screen for the drone to follow while tracking a subject. It enables cinematic shots that previously required a skilled pilot to execute manually.

Conclusion

For 99% of creators, the DJI Mini 4 Pro is the only drone they need. It's portable, powerful, and safe. Unless you need the interchangeable lenses of the Inspire 3, this is the drone to buy in 2025.
